Synopsis:
 WPP, the UK's largest advertising group, is cutting up to 1,000 additional jobs by year-end as part of an accelerating restructuring under new CEO Cindy Rose. Since early 2025, ~11,000 jobs have been shed. The turnaround strategy targets growth in 2027 via agency consolidation under a "WPP Creative" umbrella and AI integration. Asset disposals and property portfolio reduction are also underway.
